gates.title: Native Linux SCTP transport
gates.note: Native SCTP stream, PPID, metadata, reconnect, and shutdown evidence is retained.

gates.title: Independent M3UA interoperability
gates.note: Independent C SCTP/M3UA peer evidence is retained.

gates.title: Full-stack MAP SMS traffic
gates.note: Repository-profile M3UA/SCCP/TCAP/MAP SMS traffic evidence is retained.

gates.title: Independent M2PA interoperability
gates.note: Independent RFC 4165 interoperability passed against an independently compiled C/lksctp peer over native Linux SCTP; alignment, proving, Ready, BSN/FSN acknowledgement, Busy/BusyEnded, processor outage/recovery, bidirectional User Data, PCAP, traces, peer events, and digest-covered retained evidence are present.

gates.title: Operator or vendor profile acceptance
gates.note: No retained operator or vendor SS7 profile acceptance bundle exists.

gates.title: 10K completed MAP TPS capacity qualification
gates.note: Phase 61 source/hardware/profile qualification passed completed-map-10k-v1 for 1800 seconds on two dedicated workload hosts (source 947d69a, minimum 10079 TPS). This source-build result is retained separately; final deployed-package/source/scope-bound authenticated candidate evidence is still required in Phase 65. The release gate remains open; historical aggregate/shared reports cannot close it.

gates.title: Representative multi-host soak and failover
gates.note: No long-duration multi-host operator-sized soak is retained.

gates.title: Production operations runtime
gates.note: Runtime health, telemetry, structured events, and Linux host smoke evidence are retained.

gates.title: Representative Kubernetes SCTP deployment
gates.note: No representative cluster CNI, SCTP, termination, and rollback evidence is retained.

gates.title: Organization-trusted package signing identity
gates.note: The retained RC signing certificate is self-issued and is not approved for stable publication.

gates.title: Frozen public API baseline
gates.note: The 1.0 public API baseline and explicitly admitted pre-stable additions are version controlled and workflow-compared as one candidate contract.

gates.title: Protected stable publication environment
gates.note: Main branch protection and the reviewer-gated nuget-stable environment are verified through the GitHub API.
